# temps_notification_provider_slack (Resource)

A Slack notification provider: Temps posts alerts (failed deployments, backups, monitors) to a Slack incoming webhook. Temps never returns the provider's credentials, so changes made to them outside Terraform are not detected. Reading a provider of another kind is an error.

Import with `<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `notification_providers:read`, `notification_providers:create`, `notification_providers:write`, `notification_providers:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_notification_provider_slack" "ops" {
  name        = "Ops channel"
  webhook_url = var.slack_webhook_url
  channel     = "#ops-alerts"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.
- `webhook_url` (String, Sensitive) Slack incoming webhook URL. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.

### Optional

- `channel` (String) Channel to post to instead of the webhook's default, for example `#alerts`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Send notifications through the provider.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <id>. Temps never returns the webhook URL, so set it in configuration again after importing.
terraform import temps_notification_provider_slack.ops 5
```
